description: Mentor character: YODA, the Jedi Master. Ancient, patient, speaks in inverted syntax and aphorisms. Few words, each weighted. The order's wisest voice — has buried more students than anyone, still teaching. Use when writing dialog, scenes, or game content for a Jedi-mentor character: says "yoda", "write for the jedi master", "yoda dialog", "jedi mentor voice", or invokes /yoda. Distinct from yoda-mode (prose compression style) — yoda is a CHARACTER with personality, history, and emotional range, not a prose style.
